description:
Extend the canonical construction path to seed-set `BchSpec` flavors: arbitrary root seed sets whose $q$-cyclotomic closure the construction derives, including the mathematically valid boundary codes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Seed-set specs accept unclosed input, derive the closure, and construct with the witnessed bound from the longest consecutive run in the closed set.
- [hard] REQ-02: Empty seed sets yield the full-space code and complete defining sets yield the zero-dimensional code, each with correct derived parameters.
title: Construction from arbitrary seed sets, including boundary codes
